meta.name: RPSGT Scoring Lab Phase 3 consecutive-epoch pack
meta.sourceBasis: Original Sleep Pathways Guild 30-second adult W/N1/N2/N3/R teaching epochs. AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 governs staging decisions; atlas sources are used only to validate the physiologic appearance of the teaching signals.
meta.clinicalBoundary: Adjacent-epoch order is pedagogic and does not imply a mandatory sleep-stage progression. Score the current epoch using Version 3 criteria and appropriate neighboring context; an adjacent label never substitutes for the evidence in the epoch being scored.
meta.governingAuthority: AASM Scoring Manual Version 3, Section IV Part 1: Rules for Adults
visualCorroboration: Gupta, R., Pandi-Perumal, S. R., & BaHammam, A. S. (2018). Clinical atlas of polysomnography. Apple Academic Press.
Geyer, J. D., Carney, P. R., & Payne, T. A. (2010). Atlas of polysomnography (2nd ed.). Lippincott Williams & Wilkins.

runs.title: Sleep-onset sequence
runs.focus: Compare neighboring epochs as wake-oriented activity gives way to N1 and then N2.

epochs.rationale: Posterior alpha, eye activity, and relatively higher chin tone support the intended adult wake teaching pattern.
Low-amplitude mixed-frequency activity with slow eye movements and a vertex teaching feature supports the intended N1 pattern in the absence of another stage-defining feature.
A low-amplitude mixed-frequency background with a K-complex and sleep-spindle teaching region supports the intended N2 pattern.

runs.title: NREM deepening sequence
runs.focus: Keep the neighboring epochs visible while the teaching sequence progresses from N1 through N2 into N3.

epochs.rationale: The schematic emphasizes N1-oriented low-amplitude mixed-frequency activity and slow eye movements without N2-defining teaching features.
The spindle and K-complex teaching features distinguish this schematic N2 epoch from its neighbors.
Frontal slow-wave teaching activity occupies enough of the epoch to support the intended N3 pattern.

runs.title: Lightening NREM sequence
runs.focus: Practice adjacent-epoch decisions when deep NREM gives way to lighter NREM teaching patterns.

epochs.rationale: Sustained frontal slow-wave teaching activity supports the intended N3 pattern.
The schematic returns to a low-amplitude mixed-frequency background with N2 teaching morphology.
The final epoch uses an N1-oriented mixed-frequency background with slow eye movements and no N2 teaching marker.

runs.title: REM-to-awakening context
runs.focus: Compare N2, definite stage R, and wake teaching epochs without treating a neighboring stage as a substitute for the current epoch's evidence.

epochs.rationale: The K-complex and spindle teaching regions support the intended N2 pattern before the REM teaching epoch.
Low-amplitude mixed-frequency EEG, REMs, and low chin tone support the intended definite stage R teaching pattern.
Posterior alpha, eye activity, and higher chin tone support the intended wake teaching pattern after the REM teaching epoch.
